done_when: forge test --pytest selects only by two rules: changed test files, and tests that import or name the changed Python module (its dotted name or its file path); a change to a shared input (lockfiles, conftest.py, requirements, or pyproject.toml outside its safe list) runs the full command; every other selection rule and its code is removed; replaying the v1.2.6 release change selects fewer than 71 test files; one command test per rule; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each
why: The quick test picker has grown five selection rules and keeps breaking; the rule that selects any test naming a changed file picks most of the suite when a change touches forge.toml or README.md (182 of 257 test files for the v1.2.6 release)
